meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用 CDP 控制浏览器，复用登录态提取所需数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要用脚本控制 Chrome 完成自动化操作
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to reuse logins and extract data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need scripted Chrome control for automation

howto.what: Claude 能接管你的 Chrome 浏览器,用它已经登录的账号去打开网页、读取网页内容、获取登录凭证等。操作前它会先检查浏览器状态,必要时会先征求你的同意。
howto.when: 当你说出“浏览器操作”“CDP”“复用登录态”等关键词,或要求控制 Chrome 浏览器做自动化操作时触发。

say.text: 用CDP打开 example.com,提取页面文字
say.note: 会先检查浏览器状态,再打开网址并读取内容。

say.text: 从浏览器会话里取登录token
say.note: 会读取本地存储或 Cookie 获取令牌。

say.text: 操作浏览器,点一下页面上的登录按钮
say.note: 会先截取快照找到按钮,再点击。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control your Chrome browser via CDP, reusing existing login sessions. It can open URLs, run JavaScript, and extract auth tokens, etc. It first checks the browser state and asks consent before launching debug mode if needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'browser automation', 'CDP', 'reuse login session', or ask to automate/control a Chrome browser.

say_en.text: Open example.com via CDP and extract the page text.
say_en.note: Checks browser state, opens URL, then reads text.

say_en.text: Extract the login token from the current browser session.
Use browser automation to click the login button on the page.
say_en.note: Takes a snapshot to find the button, then clicks it.
